w:r.w:t: NexCore vs UFT One — Feature Comparison
Date: June 20, 2026 | NexCore Branch: feat/nexcore-advanced-upgrades | UFT Version: 23.x (OpenText)

NexCore is a modern, AI-powered QA test automation platform. UFT One (formerly HP QuickTest Professional / Micro Focus UFT) is a 20+ year enterprise tool with broad legacy application support. NexCore covers approximately 70% of UFT One's feature surface — full parity for modern web, API, and Windows desktop automation. UFT's remaining edge is deep enterprise add-ins for legacy technologies (SAP, mainframe, Oracle Forms) built over two decades.
